title: Artefacts CIT (DP companion)
description: Datapack companion for Artefacts CIT resourcespack
body:
Datapack companion for Artefacts resourcespack (version 5.1 only) used by the Minecraft Bastion Universe (MBU) server.

Use the stonecutter to get the custom models

- Netherite sword cutting

![Netherite sword cutting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/G6LyAWV9/images/300dc94e7361c88bbd615f122d74140bee150259.png)

- Carved pumpkin cutting

![Carved pumpkin cutting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/G6LyAWV9/images/5a8d21e511a88f19fceeed677c6708e09dd8bcf2.png)
